quiz.question: What does a VPN mainly protect?
options: Your traffic between your device and the VPN server
quiz.answer_text: Your traffic between your device and the VPN server
quiz.why: A VPN encrypts the connection, so people on the same Wi-Fi can't read your traffic. It isn't antivirus.
